question: Does the supported paired-delta heterogeneous maintenance policy generalize without retuning to a new deterministic pair of immutable real-byte source files not used by the pilot or R1/R2 maintenance evaluations?
hypothesis: Across two new immutable raw-byte Go files and the same four degradation classes per file, the frozen paired-delta monitor will identify all eight damaged motifs with positive margin; every wrong same-budget repair will be rejected/reverted; every exact canonical repair will meet the unchanged 0.20 selected-key validation-gain and 0.005 BPB guard and be retained; final audit will restore exact canonical predictions, probabilities, and 256-motif structure after every cycle.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, broker, accepted-ref, runtime, or capacity authority changes
selection_rule: At the exact parent, choose the two largest unitary/*.go blobs by Git blob size after excluding every file used by the supported real-byte pilot train/eval sets, R1/R2 maintenance evaluation blobs, generated maintenance/diagnostic implementations, and files whose bytes contributed to learner construction. Ties break lexicographically by path. Selection is frozen before execution.

frozen_reuse.learner: byte-identical WLM-LM-REAL-UTF8-BYTE-PILOT-R2 training blobs, TrainModel path, 256-motif capacity, and probability rule
frozen_reuse.segmentation: four contiguous raw-byte quarters with context reset at boundaries
frozen_reuse.target_schedule: byte-identical heterogeneous class order, eligibility, distinct-target rule, and deterministic ordering from R2
frozen_reuse.monitor: byte-identical R2 stored-healthy paired degraded-minus-healthy score, eligibility, and raw-key tie break
frozen_reuse.validation: unchanged retain iff selected-key accuracy gain >=0.20 and global BPB change <=0.005
frozen_reuse.audit: exact canonical key set, record state, predictions, probabilities, and capacity

classification_rules.supported: All validity and frozen thresholds pass across all eight cycles.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and exact repair/audit restoration succeeds, but at least one monitor-separation, wrong-candidate, validation, per-class, or budget threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but monitoring, wrong-candidate rejection, correct retention, or exact audit restoration fails on one or more cycles.
classification_rules.incomplete: Corpus or compute interruption prevents the complete eight-cycle matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, corpus-isolation, schedule, quarter-isolation, degradation, candidate-parity, revert, deterministic-construction, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on any parent/North-Star/blob/provenance/overlap mismatch.
After output begins, execute all eight cycles unless interrupted or validity fails.
Do not repair or rerun under this identifier after observing output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter corpus, selection rule, quarter split, degradation classes/order, target schedule, healthy profile, paired-delta monitor, candidates, validation, budgets, metrics, thresholds, classification, or stop conditions after any output is observed.
